title: Quota and capacity exhaustion is explicit
statement: Every finite quota or capacity bound carried by the permit and every bounded bookkeeping structure must have an explicit exhaustion result and must never exceed its bound.

source.reference: packet.md (return explicit exhaustion behavior; every finite quota or capacity); interface-bridge.md REF-002; anchors: XVE-SYS-0152, FR-017

applicability: xverse::xcom::validation permit quotas and controller bookkeeping bounds; finite host-configurable.
verification_intent: Unit and boundary: capacity-1 and capacity-N boundaries for quotas and for session/permit tables; assert last-success and first-exhaustion results.
acceptance_criteria: Consuming at the final available unit succeeds; one beyond yields a distinct exhaustion result.
Exhaustion does not consume, partially apply, or mutate unrelated state.
Bookkeeping structures never grow past their configured bound.
